item.description:

item.title: More than half of researchers now use AI for peer review, often against guidance
item.description:
📝 Email Bluesky Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Whatsapp X Survey results suggest that peer reviewers are increasingly turning to AI. Nearly one-quarter of respondents said that they had increased their use of AI for peer review over the past year. “AI should be used in peer review responsibly, with very clear guides, with human accountability and with the right training,” says Vicario.
🔗 Read more: https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-025-04066-5

item.title: Ask HN: Does anyone understand how Hacker News works?
item.description:
📝 ”What I find strange is that Hacker News feels oddly opaque. Not just the rules, but the dynamics: what’s repeatable, what’s luck, and what actually matters. So I’m asking sincerely: Does anyone here feel they understand Hacker News.
